Catalog at dsh-research.com."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-research"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# Research plugins, from the Plugins page"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-research) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A curated market for literature search, reference management, writing and review plugins. Open **Plu"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"gins → Installed → dsh-research**, or use **Settings → Research plugins**. Each Install button adds "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"the selected plugin to the profile you are running."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Restart DSH Desktop or `dsh web`, then open **Plugins → Installed → dsh-research**. **Settings → Res"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"earch plugins** remains available, including on older Harness versions."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## dsh-research.com"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The catalog behind the panel lives at **dsh-research.com** — the same list, in a browser, at /plugin"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"s. Each entry says what the plugin does and where it stops, and there is a walkthrough that goes fro"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"m an empty machine to a finished talk. The site is generated from one JSON file; the panel fetches t"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"hat same file, so the two can never drift apart."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The official market already installs anything in the community registry, and does it well. What it c"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"annot do is tell a researcher which of its eleven hundred plugins are theirs. That is the part this "},{"id":"p12s3","text":" do is tell a researcher which of its eleven hundred plugins are theirs. That is the part this does."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What an install actually does"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The panel runs `dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add <package>` for you — the same command you wo"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"uld type. Four things fence it:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| **Allowlist** | The browser may ask for any package name; only a package this catalog lists is eve"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"r spawned. The catalog is a static file we publish. |
| **Same-origin** | A state-changing route rea"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"chable from any page would let a site you visited install into your profile. |
| **One at a time** |"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" Two concurrent `dsh plugin add` runs race on one `package.json` and can leave a profile half-writte"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"n. |
| **Your profile, not a guess** | The target comes from the `--profile` this host booted, so ru"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"nning a test profile never mutates your real one. |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Set `allowInstall: false` to keep the panel read-only."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The bundle inserts one row (`id: research-market`). Override it from your profile's `cordis.patch.ym"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"l` (a patch replaces the whole `config`, so restate every key you keep):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`catalogUrl` accepts any endpoint answering the DSH Community Market provider contract. Point it at "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"your own and the panel lists yours instead."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Notes"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- The panel's list and the one at dsh-research.com/plugins are the same list, built from the same `m"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"arket.json`. Nothing reaches it unread: installing someone else's package from a button we drew make"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"s us the first place their bug gets reported.
- The process layer is adapted from dsh-market (MIT), "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"which worked out that `ctx.shell` cannot write to a profile, that a macOS app launched from the Dock"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" has no Homebrew on PATH, that pnpm v10 hangs without a TTY unless `CI` is set, and that Windows `ds"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"h` is a `.cmd` shim.
- A newly installed plugin needs a restart before it loads; the row says so."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
